entities.summary: Kazuyuki Kaneda  is a Japanese professional baseball pitcher for the Orix Buffaloes in Japan's Nippon Professional Baseball. Kaneda was drafted 5th in the 2012 draft and made his first team debut on opening day of the 2014 season, pitching a scoreless 7th inning against the Yomiuri Giants.
